title: ze_SAMOSBOR
description:
SAMOSBOR 

 This is a Zombie Escape map and can't be played in offline / Это Zombie Escape карта и её нельзя поиграть в одиночке 

 This map is made for Source2ZE Mapping Contest «Return to Roots». To properly play this map, you will need the necessary plugins from Source2ZE, which are available at their GitHub. 

For server owners: for the fair play, please enable the cvar mp_spectators_max if its disabled on the server, so spectators can't abuse and find a way to the next floor.

GIGA-KHRUSHCHEVKA is a huge and endless complex consisting of thousands of connected residential blocks. None of the residents know what a GIGA-KHRUSHCHEVKA is or how it appeared; it is also unknown when, by whom and why it was built...

It exists and functions autonomously, without an entrance or exit accessible to residents. It periodically suffers from unauthorized SAMOSBORS. It looks like a mess of shabby old Khrushchevkas, Soviet factory blocks and other things. If there are windows in the complex, they overlook other clusters of residential areas. It is a permanent home for the inhabitants of GIGA-KHRUSHCHEVKA. Generations replace each other, but life in the complex has not changed in any way, according to some sources, for 3 generations (not confirmed).

The map contains:
- 5 FLOORS
- 2 Endings (1 is a Secret ending)
- Human and Zombie items
- Traps
and more..

And always remember.. BEWARE of SAMOSBOR!
